strategies.title: Strategy Control
strategies.disposition: Phase 1 remains exactly APPROVED_SPACE_EXHAUSTED / RESEARCH_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and Phase 2 evidence remains unchanged. Mean-reversion v2 and relative-value rotation v2 remain IMPLEMENTATION_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT; their v3 successor preflights found nonlocal evaluator obligations before any new repair or economic evaluation, and neither was shown profitable or unprofitable. Route 4 remains deferred with DIRECTION_DESIGN_INCONCLUSIVE / NO_DATA_RESULT / NO_ECONOMIC_RESULT, and funding remains a causally waiting collection checkpoint. The latest closed funding report contained 63,650 expected observations across ten registered streams; realized settlements are not joined, Binance executable bid/ask is absent, and fees and slippage are not frozen. This is collection-health evidence, not a strategy result or profitability evidence. The first Phase 3 milestone, one clean development economic result, has not been reached. No candidate is promoted; final holdouts remain unresolved, sealed, unopened, and unread; no orders, credentials, capital, leverage, paid data, paid compute, training, backtest, returns, GPU use, or mining change occurred.
